newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Milan Dec CPI data to be issued on Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Milan Dec CPI data to be issued on Dec 20.

text.p: The Italian city of Milan will publish its preliminary December consumer price index (CPI) figures on Friday, December 20, the city press office said.
The data will be released, as usual, after 1630 GMT.
Milan is one of 10 sample Italian cities that issues monthly preliminary CPI data. The city has a weighting of just under 20 percent on the national index.
Official December national inflation details will be published on January 8.
In November, Milan posted a month-on-month CPI rise of 0.3 percent and a year-on-year rate of 2.7 percent, against a national monthly rise of 0.3 percent and annual rate of 2.6 percent in October.
